lines.line: Her behaviour is controlled by a state machine.
She rests in her chair. When the light comes on, she notices it, walks over, and kicks the switch off.
If you hold the switch on, her kicks fail. After a few failures, she might lean on the switch instead.
If she fails enough times, she gives up, sulks, and ignores you.
If you keep holding it, every now and then she runs at the switch, just to check.
If you turn the light off, she walks back to her chair in the dark. If you flip the switch on and off quickly while she walks, she loses her temper and stomps.
There is no machine learning involved, only states, timers, and a little randomness.
